searchText: hey guys, I'm not sure at what state the current implementation of the test ceremony supposed to be, but I have submitted a message this morning about 6h ago, and it still just rotating around. Is it supposed to be like that ? <Marcin> That's a bug, fixed recently by PlasmaPower and merged into main just minutes ago :) the sequencer will restart shortly and you should be able to use it Maybe worthwhile to make a note here, to not leave the page. Also probably worthwhile to try to make some kind of time countdown, even if its just a bad estimate, its better to have something to look at ticking down than nothing. Should there be an option on the frontend to download the signed contribution receipt? I think that'd make sense. <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> good suggestion! we're looking to add little things like this to make the experience smoother (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <Barnabas> Maybe worthwhile to make a note here, to not leave the page. Also probably worthwhile to try to make some kind of time countdown, even if its just a bad estimate, its better to have something to look at ticking down than nothing. https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/974028042257190933/1050070332578484304/Screenshot_2022-12-07_at_16.23.54.png) <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> yes, we're considering this as well. it would likely be on the contribution page (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <PlasmaPower> Should there be an option on the frontend to download the signed contribution receipt? I think that'd make sense.) I was thinking of the "Sequencer Acknowledgement" page, since if the sequencer is providing a signature back to users that their contribution is included it'd make sense for them to save it in case of future dispute <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> as a new page? (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <PlasmaPower> [reply]: I was thinking of the "Sequencer Acknowledgement" page, since if the sequencer is providing a signature back to users that their contribution is included it'd make sense for them to save it in case of future dispute) No, next to the "Share on Twitter" button or something Just a "Download Receipt" button the frontend could locally generate a data url with the receipt and its sequencer signature, and then download that, avoiding any new APIs or anything <nicoserranop> > <nicoserranop> That sounds good! :) downloading it as json would be okay? I just posted an issue https://github.com/zkparty/trusted-setup-frontend/issues/99 (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <PlasmaPower> the frontend could locally generate a data url with the receipt and its sequencer signature, and then download that, avoiding any new APIs or anything) Hi ^^ I'm interested into contributing to the kzg-ceremony with another implementation (I hope that I'm not too late). Currently I have some code in Go to generate the powers of tau, verify the contributions, etc. I was trying to find info about the api of the sequencer, in order to get on the queue and contribute, but I'm not able to find it. There is any resource that shows the endpoints & msgs/jsons to use and the authentication methods to get on the queue? Thanks a lot in advance <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> nice to see you again! you're not too late, we're still testing and ironing out bugs! i'll let one of the dev contributors point you in the right direction (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <arnaucube> Hi ^^ I'm interested into contributing to the kzg-ceremony with another implementation (I hope that I'm not too late). Currently I have some code in Go to generate the powers of tau, verify the contributions, etc. I was trying to find info about the api of the sequencer, in order to get on the queue and contribute, but I'm not able to find it. There is any resource that shows the endpoints & msgs/jsons to use and the authentication methods to get on the queue? Thanks a lot in advance) https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/tree/master/apiSpec but there are some problems with it thank you! (reacted to the msg with an emoji-reaction, but not sure if that is bridged by the telegram-bot) <@709429996468305980> We also started a go implementation here: https://github.com/dknopik/towers-of-pau/tree/proper-client It's able to fetch the ceremony but authentication is still borked (didn't have time to fix it) oh nice! Thanks! The one that I'm doing is this one: https://github.com/arnaucube/eth-kzg-ceremony-alt (good thing is that we use differnt bls12-381 libraries, so we keep a bit of diversity ☺️ ) I also have a branch with the kilic library (so I could cross compile to wasm and run in the browser). But then I'm not going to move to kilic :) Don't want to run in the browser anyway^^ I have created this implementation: https://github.com/StefanBratanov/chotto I might have a go at a rust cli impl with frame support for signing your contribution sometime over the weekend 🙂 It would be really nice if we could have a different authentication mechanism than oidc, just sign something with your sk. Open id connect seems such horrible enterprise crap to me I could have a look at implementing signing in by just passing in a signature of something with a nonce over the weekend instead <CarlBeek> Replacing oidc with a signature has been a hot topic of debate recently. ideally the signature of your entropy as this would allow for only needing a single signature to be generated client side. While implementing this technically is fairly easy, I am reticent to go down that path as the sequencer and zkparty frontend are post-audit and this would require breaking changes to the api plus big PRs against the codebases.
